'''Troonol''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] member of the [[Qunaalac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a Qunalaac [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]''. His [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] was the ''[[Agrelcu Haalta]]''.
